data.long_meaning: The name Affrica is derived from the Latin word 'Affricus', which means 'lover of Africa'. This name carries a deep connection to the land and people of Africa, evoking feelings of love, compassion, and respect. The name Affrica carries the meaning “Love for Africa” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Affrica usually hope their child will grow to embody love for africa and live with faith, good character and purpose.
